responsibility: Independently translates a verified objection cycle into an immutable operational self-assessment that bounds what a later recovery must preserve and may change, without granting execution authority.
mutation_interface: OperationalSelfAssessment.assess appends at most one deterministic assessment per objection cycle; verify is read-only
execution_location: in-process deterministic assessment over append-only authority; no model, network, candidate execution or host action
failure_boundary: fail_closed — absent or malformed objection, review, verification or execution-input authority, any digest mismatch, an unknown recovery decision, or a task with no objection refuses before an assessment is appended
recovery_behavior: Idempotent by objection cycle — an identical retry verifies and returns the existing assessment, while append-only SQL prevents replacement or reinterpretation
replacement_contract: A replacement must independently recompute the objection, review, verification and execution-input facts; use the closed three-way disposition vocabulary; preserve target, vectors, entrypoint and apparatus identity; additionally preserve the candidate for evidence-only resubmission; permit only candidate_source, execution_evidence or nothing according to the recorded recovery decision; and remain unable to authorize or execute its own recommendation
evidence_produced: one content-addressed operational_assessments row per assessed objection cycle
a closed disposition and failure class
explicit preserved bindings, permitted changes and mandatory recovery checks
a trajectory event recording the deterministic assessment outcome
